about.title: A trusted technical partner for the crane industry
about.intro: PALFINGER VIPEC distributes genuine parts and provides technical services for knuckle boom cranes, serving transportation, construction, mining and logistics companies. We stand with our customers throughout the entire operating life of their equipment.
about.missionDesc: Keep every knuckle boom crane running safely, efficiently and reliably through genuine parts and standardized technical service.
about.visionDesc: To become the most trusted knuckle boom crane service partner in the Vietnamese market.
about.cap1: A wide genuine parts inventory ready for fast supply
about.cap3: Scheduled maintenance programs with full equipment records
about.cap4: Remote technical support and on-site dispatch when needed
about.teamDesc: Our engineers and technicians bring years of hands-on experience across knuckle boom crane models, continuously trained on the latest technology and maintenance procedures.
about.noteDesc: PALFINGER VIPEC is an authorized parts distribution and technical service partner in the Vietnamese market, not a global representative office of the manufacturer.
about.showcaseImageAlt: UD tractor unit fitted with a PALFINGER SPK32080C 12-ton knuckle boom crane
about.teamImageAlt: The PALFINGER VIPEC team at a product launch event

services.title: Complete technical solutions for knuckle boom cranes
services.subtitle: We support our customers with repairs, scheduled maintenance, and genuine replacement parts guidance.
services.s1Desc: Diagnose and fix knuckle boom crane faults — hydraulic systems, mechanical structure, electrical systems — using genuine parts.
services.s2Desc: Scheduled maintenance based on operating hours, keeping the crane running reliably and extending equipment life.
services.s3Desc: Proper crane installation, system calibration, and safe-operation training for your team.
services.s4Desc: A mobile technical team ready to respond to urgent breakdowns, minimizing downtime.
services.s5Desc: Structural, hydraulic and operational safety inspections in line with current standards.
services.s6Desc: Advice on choosing the correct part number for your specific crane model, avoiding incompatible purchases.
services.ctaTitle: Need to schedule repair or maintenance?
services.heroImageAlt: VIPEC technicians servicing a hydraulic system at the service workshop
services.process1Desc: Customer contacts us via hotline or website, describing the crane condition or need.
services.process2Desc: A technician assesses the job (on-site or remote) and provides a plan with a firm quote.
services.process3Desc: Repair, maintenance or installation is carried out per the agreed plan.
services.process4Desc: Test run and inspection, then handover with care instructions for the customer.
